Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.createTranscriptionRequestFromJson("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.transcribe(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.text)
debugPrint(result.segments as Any)
```
